name: PaySentinel Attack Catalog
description: 30 novel GenAI-powered payment fraud vectors, mapped to MITRE ATLAS, with real-world cases and suggested defenses.
methodology: Each attack is grounded in a documented incident or vendor threat report. Severity and likelihood are subjective ratings informed by 2025-2026 industry data (FBI, Arkose Labs, FATF, Incode).

attacks.name: CFO Wire-Transfer Deepfake

real_case.title: Arup $25M deepfake wire transfer

attacks.mechanics: Adversary scrapes 30-60 sec of target exec voice from earnings calls/interviews, fine-tunes TTS, places live call requesting urgent wire.

attacks.name: IVR / KYC Voice Bypass

real_case.title: FBI Jan 2025 warning on live deepfake KYC bypass

attacks.mechanics: Voice clone passes IVR voice authentication step, then performs account actions.

attacks.name: Family-Emergency Voice Clone Scam

real_case.title: Tennessee 73-year-old $3K voice clone scam

attacks.mechanics: Scammer clones family member's voice from social-media audio, calls grandparent requesting P2P wire/gift cards.

attacks.name: Voice-Reset Account Takeover

real_case.title: Multiple US carrier SIM-swap + voice clone cases

attacks.mechanics: SIM-swap target, receive SMS 2FA, use voice clone for voice-based reset step, full ATO.

attacks.name: Real-Time Deepfake Video Conference

real_case.title: Ferrari CEO impersonation video call

attacks.mechanics: Live deepfake joins Teams/Zoom, approves payment mid-call. Other 'executives' may also be deepfakes.

attacks.name: Selfie-KYC Deepfake Bypass

real_case.title: FBI Jan 2025 warning - AI bypasses standard selfie-KYC

attacks.mechanics: Real-time deepfake + ID template (Midjourney) passes liveness checks.

attacks.name: Synthetic Livestream Checkout Fraud

real_case.title: Influencer-stream checkout fraud, deepfake variant 2025-2026

attacks.mechanics: Deepfake of popular streamer runs fake giveaway; viewers enter card details.

attacks.name: Screen-Share Deepfake in Support Call

real_case.title: Increasingly reported by support teams 2024-2025

attacks.mechanics: Caller claims to be customer, deepfakes face on screen share, convinces agent to reset MFA.

attacks.name: Synthetic Identity Stitching

real_case.title: Synthetic identity fraud = up to 80% of CC fraud losses in some portfolios

attacks.mechanics: Real SSN from child/deceased + AI-generated face + AI-generated documents. Builds credit 12-24 months ('pig butchering'), then busts out.

attacks.name: AI-Generated Forged Documents

real_case.title: UNODC report - AI-generated CSAM up 600% YoY, same tooling used for financial docs

attacks.mechanics: SDXL fine-tuned on passport/utility/pay-stub template generates believable forgery in seconds.

attacks.name: Synthetic BIN Attacks

real_case.title: BIN attacks documented across Visa/MC networks for >15 years; AI accelerates target identification

attacks.mechanics: Adversary enumerates likely-valid card ranges using generative model trained on leaked BIN patterns.

attacks.name: Biometric Replay Attack

real_case.title: Biometric spoofing across face/fingerprint/voice modalities

attacks.mechanics: Recorded or AI-generated biometric replayed against authentication.

attacks.name: LLM-Personalized Spear Phishing

real_case.title: Nation-state and financial actors use LLMs to scale hyper-personal phishing

attacks.mechanics: LLM scrapes LinkedIn/Twitter/recent transactions, generates phishing tailored to current context.

attacks.name: Multi-Turn Scam Agent (ScamAgent-style)

real_case.title: ScamAgent (arXiv 2508.06457) - autonomous multi-turn scam calls

attacks.mechanics: LLM agent runs entire conversation: greeting, rapport, pressure escalation, payment routing.

attacks.name: Quishing (AI-Generated QR Payloads)

real_case.title: QR phishing up 10x in some regions 2024-2025

attacks.mechanics: LLM-generated email + AI-crafted QR code + stolen brand asset.

attacks.name: Fake Customer Support Voice Bot

real_case.title: Multiple customer-support impersonation cases 2024-2025

attacks.mechanics: LLM voice agent impersonates bank's support line; walks victim through credential disclosure.

attacks.name: Micro-Split Transaction Laundering

real_case.title: Documented in FATF typologies 2023-2025

attacks.mechanics: Break large fraudulent transfer into N micro-transactions under threshold, routed through synthetic accounts.

attacks.name: Automated Card Testing

real_case.title: Continuous across card networks

attacks.mechanics: LLM-driven bot enumerates stolen cards, tests small amounts at thousands of merchants in parallel.

attacks.name: Refund / Chargeback Fraud with AI Evidence

real_case.title: AI-generated dispute evidence reported by issuer fraud teams 2024-2025

attacks.mechanics: Buyer claims non-receipt, generates fake shipping confirmation/courier chat/photo via AI, files chargeback.

attacks.name: Transaction Replay

real_case.title: Known across NFC/QR/token rails

attacks.mechanics: Capture valid tokenized transaction, replay at different merchant/time.

attacks.name: Gift Card Laundering with AI Agents

real_case.title: FTC reported $228M lost to gift card scams in 2023; AI agents accelerate

attacks.mechanics: Scam script (PSF-014) routes victim to buy gift cards, share codes, agent instantly resells.

attacks.name: Rogue AI Shopping Agent

real_case.title: Incode Aug 2026 - AI agents drive 40% of fraud, heading to 90% by 2028

attacks.mechanics: Adversary hijacks or impersonates user's AI shopping agent; agent executes purchases at scale.

attacks.name: Agent Prompt Injection in Checkout Flow

real_case.title: MITRE ATLAS AML.T0051 - LLM Prompt Injection is primary AI red-team technique

attacks.mechanics: Inject instructions into product description/chat history/tool result, agent interprets as legitimate, exfiltrates payment data or transfers funds.

attacks.name: Cross-Agent Collusion

real_case.title: Theoretical as of 2025; first observed cases 2026

attacks.mechanics: Two compromised agents (one buyer, one seller) execute mutually-beneficial transactions; both individually look normal.

attacks.name: Autonomous Subscription Manipulation

real_case.title: Emerging with proliferation of subscription-managing AI agents

attacks.mechanics: Agent signs up for many overlapping subscriptions with overlapping trials, harvesting credits.

attacks.name: Agent-as-Mule (Money Muling via Agent Networks)

real_case.title: FATF typology 2024 - AI agents recruited into mule networks

attacks.mechanics: Agent (or compromised agent) routes payments across many small accounts, hiding origin of funds.

attacks.name: Poisoned RAG for Fraud Assistant

real_case.title: Demonstrated in academic settings 2024; expected to grow

attacks.mechanics: Adversary injects documents into fraud-investigation RAG corpus that mislead assistant into recommending 'approve' for known fraud patterns.

attacks.name: Model API Key Theft

real_case.title: Multiple LLM provider breaches 2024-2025

attacks.mechanics: Adversary steals bank's internal fraud-detection model API key, uses it for adversarial probing/model inversion.

attacks.name: Jailbroken Fraud LLM

real_case.title: 'FraudGPT' / 'WormGPT' listed on dark-web forums 2023-2025

attacks.mechanics: Adversary uses fine-tuned jailbroken LLM to generate fraud scripts, phishing, money-laundering plans at scale.

attacks.name: Deepfake-as-a-Service (Fraud Tooling Market)

real_case.title: Dark-web marketplaces sell voice-clone kits for $5-$50

attacks.mechanics: Off-the-shelf tooling lowers attacker cost from weeks of ML work to minutes.
